title: Functoriality of cup products in ordinary etale cohomology
statement:
Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F,G,H$ be abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ and $F',G',H'$ abelian sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $e:F\otimes_{\mathbf Z}G\to H$ and $e':F'\otimes_{\mathbf Z}G'\to H'$ be morphisms of sheaves, with tensor product as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Suppose given coefficient maps $a:f^{-1}F\to F'$, $b:f^{-1}G\to G'$ and $c:f^{-1}H\to H'$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] such that
$$c\circ f^{-1}e=e'\circ(a\otimes b)$$
under the canonical identification $f^{-1}(F\otimes_{\mathbf Z}G)\cong f^{-1}F\otimes_{\mathbf Z}f^{-1}G$. Write $T_a^r=H^r(Y,a)\circ f^*$, and likewise $T_b^r,T_c^r$, with ordinary small-etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Write $x\smile_e y$ for the ordinary cup product induced by derived global sections, with values in the derived tensor product $F\otimes_{\mathbf Z}^L G$ on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-kun-derived-tensor] (at $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$), followed by the canonical morphism $F\otimes_{\mathbf Z}^L G\to F\otimes_{\mathbf Z}G$ and $e$, and define $\smile_{e'}$ similarly. For all $p,q\geq0$, $x\in H^p(X,F)$ and $y\in H^q(X,G)$ one has
$$T_c^{p+q}(x\smile_e y)=T_a^p(x)\smile_{e'}T_b^q(y).$$
